messages:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: streaming p99 for route 'audio-transcribe' (canary-variant-audio-v2) crossed 6000ms — SLO 1500ms. dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/streams/audio?panel=latency
Alice M: I'm looking. Is canary still at 20%? any recent deploys?
DeployBot: deploy audio-v2-canary rolled at 5090012000, canary_percent=20, rollout=gradual
Luis (support): We have 6 support tickets mentioning 'audio cuts out' or 'stalls' in the last 8m. Customers on EU region mostly.
Jordan (ml): The v2 change included a different encoder reorder + 8-bit quant profile. I flagged memory patterns but not stalls. Could be KV cache pressure with streaming multiplex.
Samira (sre): Observed metrics: p95 jumped 900ms -> 1800ms; p99 spiked to ~6200ms. Concurrent open streams with >2s idle chunk increased x3. Streaming stalls correlate with high kv_cache_evictions on canary hosts.
Mike (infra): Quick mitigation: shift audio-transcribe route back to stable pool and drop canary to 0%. Also disable multiplexing for audio streaming on canaries while we investigate.
Alice M: OK executing traffic shift now. Will apply rollback if shift doesn't help immediately.
Alice M: ```
# shift canary -> stable
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.internal/routes/audio/traffic" \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx' \
  -d '{"canary_percent":0, "stable_percent":100}'
```
DeployBot: traffic change requested by Alice M. Applying on edge-proxy fleet.
Mike (infra): Kicked rollback for canary instances: draining canary tasks running audio-v2 and routing new sessions to stable. ETA ~45s to full drain.
Samira (sre): After 60s: KV cache evictions down 70%, p99 falling to ~1200ms, streaming stalls metric decreasing. Monitoring for regressions.
Luis (support): Confirmed with 2 customers: streaming resumed, fewer stalls. One EU customer still sees short glitches, might be edge tail.
Jordan (ml): Preliminary hypothesis: quant profile changed memory access causing sporadic long kernel runs on specific GPU combos (A100-80GB + old cuda driver). Will repro locally and instrument attention kernel times.
Samira (sre): Saving traces and logs: ```
[stream-id=0x7f3a] stall_detected: idle_chunk=2300ms, kv_evictions=12, kernel_time=520ms
[host=canary-34] gpu=0 A100 kernel_attention: 498ms
[host=canary-34] kv_cache.size=1.2GB -> evict
```
Alice M: Good catch. I'm going to hand this for follow-up to Mike for mitigation and Jordan for ML tweak. Oncall handoff in 10m — Mike you'll own the bridge for postmortem and re-roll plan?
Mike (infra): Affirmative. I'll own post-incident triage, coordinate with ML on quant rollback and with infra to patch driver/kernel scheduling if needed.
DeployBot: Canary percent set to 0 by Alice M at 5090012580.
Samira (sre): Paging cleared for immediate customer impact. Keeping watch for 10m. I'll file a high-priority incident doc with timeline and attach traces.
Luis (support): I'll notify affected customers that we've rolled back the canary and are investigating root cause; will escalate any remaining reports.
Alice M: Closing urgent paging thread. If p99 climbs again or new errors appear, re-open and page oncall. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
